<p class=\"widget__hint gc-muted\">Setpo: Setpoint is a 300 °/s step for 300 ms on one axis. This is a teaching model: motors with ~20 ms lag, a 2 kHz loop, D on the filtered gyro; “Loop delay” is the total pure delay (filters + ESC + transmission), and it eats your phase margin. Turn P, I, D, FF, noise and the filter: watch the overshoot, the bounce-back after the stop, and how D turns noise into motor jitter. The trends are honest, the absolute numbers are not.
<p class=\"widget__hint gc-muted\">Введи: Enter the takeoff weight with the battery, the number of motors, the max thrust of one motor from the manufacturer's table, hover efficiency (g/W from the same table at thrust ≈ weight / number of motors) and the battery. The chart shows flight time vs. added payload: you can see where the aircraft stops being useful.
<p class=\"widget__hint gc-muted\">Выбер: Pick the band, mode, power and telemetry ratio. The table shows the packet interval, the telemetry interval and the relative range based on the mode's sensitivity (every +6 dB of budget ≈ ×2 distance in free space). Sensitivities come from the ExpressLRS “Signal Health” table; this is the lowest RSSI at which the link is still alive, so the warning is set 5–10 dB higher.
<p class=\"widget__hint gc-muted\">Высот: The altitude drifts slowly (green), the barometer is noisy (yellow). The top two sliders are the real world, the bottom two are what the filter thinks of it (Q and R). Tune Q and R so the estimate (light blue) follows the drift but not the noise, and compare its error with the raw sensor's error.
<p class=\"widget__hint gc-muted\">Камер: Camera pointing at nadir over flat ground. The long side of the frame is across the flight line. A red tag means the camera can't shoot at the required interval (typically 1–2 s per frame for compact cameras).
<p class=\"widget__hint gc-muted\">Крен: The aircraft's roll rotates its linear antenna relative to the ground antenna; the elevation angle is how high the aircraft is above the ground antenna. A vertical dipole “can't see” straight up. Compare a linear pair with circular polarization and see how many dB an overhead pass costs.
<p class=\"widget__hint gc-muted\">Крути: Turn roll/pitch/yaw (ZYX order, FRD axes: x forward, y right, z down). On the right are the quaternion (w, x, y, z) and the rotation matrix. Set pitch = 90°: roll and yaw start rotating the model about the same axis — that's gimbal lock, which the quaternion doesn't have.
<p class=\"widget__hint gc-muted\">Линии: The lines are the motor 1st, 2nd and 3rd harmonic frequencies vs. throttle. The horizontal lines are Betaflight filter settings. If the fundamental at working throttle is below rpm_filter_min_hz, the RPM filter doesn't catch it — that's the slow 10" motors case from the module.
<p class=\"widget__hint gc-muted\">Свобо: Free space is an optimistic bound: terrain, the Fresnel zone, the airframe and interference take their share, so in flight you keep ~10 dB of margin. Every 6 dB of margin doubles the range.
<p class=\"widget__hint gc-muted\">Сумма: Sum of average delays along the chain: radio → RF link → receiver → FC (smoothing, loop, filters) → ESC → motor. This is a teaching model: it shows which links actually matter. Video is a separate row, based on typical published ranges.
<p class=\"widget__hint gc-muted\">Ток,: Current, length of one wire (outbound; the return wire is accounted for automatically) and bus voltage. The table shows the drop and heat for each gauge. Rule of thumb: drop ≤ 2–3 % of the bus, heat no more than a few watts on a short run; for long wing harnesses, go up a gauge.
<p class=\"widget__hint gc-muted\">Цепоч: The chain as in Betaflight: RPM notch (3 harmonics) → dynamic notch → LPF1 → LPF2. The yellow band is motor noise (±8 %: RPM wanders, so attenuation is computed over the band, not at a point). At the bottom is the delay the filters add to the useful control signal (20 Hz). Move the cutoffs and see how attenuation in the motor band is paid for with delay.
